selection_protocol.numeric: Decimal from original number strings; recall>=floor, strict at1.0; maximise QPS; preserve all ties; no interpolation, rounding up, non-CPU substitution, memory/build exclusion, or recall-metric substitution.
selection_protocol.frontier: create_pointset produces per-algorithm Pareto frontiers; maximumQPS at a recall floor is preserved by this transformation for the records supplied to the plotter. This does not establish completeness of unpublished records or current2025 results.
selection_protocol.parser: balanced-array scanner respects JS strings; regex accepts numeric x/y and a JSON double-quoted label; all data-array residue must consist only of whitespace/commas, and all point counts must match. No downloaded JavaScript is executed.

import re,json,hashlib
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
DATASETS=[('glove-100-angular','angular','site-glove.html'),('glove-25-angular','angular','glove-25-angular.html'),('nytimes-256-angular','angular','nytimes-256-angular.html'),('fashion-mnist-784-euclidean','euclidean','fashion-mnist-784-euclidean.html'),('gist-960-euclidean','euclidean','gist-960-euclidean.html'),('sift-128-euclidean','euclidean','sift-128-euclidean.html'),('sift-256-hamming','hamming','sift-256-hamming.html'),('word2bits-800-hamming','hamming','word2bits-800-hamming.html'),('kosarak-jaccard','jaccard','kosarak-jaccard.html')]
CHARTS={'chartRecallQueries per second (1/s)':'qps','chartRecallBuild time (s)':'build_seconds','chartRecallIndex size (kB)':'index_size_kb','chartRecallPercentile 99 (millis)':'p99_ms'}
POINT=re.compile(r'\{\s*x:\s*([-+0-9.eE]+)\s*,\s*y:\s*([-+0-9.eE]+)\s*,\s*label:\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")\s*\}')
LABEL=re.compile(r'label:\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")\s*,\s*fill:')
def array(s,start):
    assert s[start]=='['
    stack=[];quote=None;escape=False
    for i in range(start,len(s)):
        c=s[i]
        if quote:
            if escape:escape=False
            elif c=='\\':escape=True
            elif c==quote:quote=None
        elif c in '\"\'':quote=c
        elif c in '[{(':stack.append(c)
        elif c in ']})':
            assert stack and {'[':']','{':'}','(':')'}[stack.pop()]==c
            if not stack:return s[start+1:i]
    raise ValueError('unbalanced array')
def parse_page(path):
    text=path.read_text(); charts={}; counts={}
    scripts=[m for m in re.finditer(r'<script\b[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',text,re.S)if 'new Chart' in m.group(1)]
    assert len(scripts)==13
    for script in scripts:
        js=script.group(1)
        chart_id=json.loads(re.search(r'getElementById\(("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")\)',js).group(1))
        if chart_id not in CHARTS:continue
        metric=CHARTS[chart_id];assert metric not in charts
        arr_start=js.index('[',js.index('datasets:')); body=array(js,arr_start)
        labels=list(LABEL.finditer(body)); points=[];algorithms=[]
        assert labels
        for j,label in enumerate(labels):
            algo=json.loads(label.group(1));algorithms.append(algo)
            end=labels[j+1].start()if j+1<len(labels)else len(body)
            section=body[label.end():end]; data_start=section.index('[',section.index('data:')); data=array(section,data_start)
            assert re.sub(r'[\s,]','',POINT.sub('',data))=='',str(path)+' unparsed point schema'
            for point in POINT.finditer(data):
                x,y=map(Decimal,point.group(1,2));assert x.is_finite()and y.is_finite()and 0<=x<=1 and y>=0
                if metric=='qps':assert y>0
                offset=script.start(1)+arr_start+1+label.end()+data_start+1+point.start()
                points.append({'algorithm':algo,'recall':point.group(1),'value':point.group(2),'label':json.loads(point.group(3)),'line':text.count('\n',0,offset)+1})
        assert len(points)==len(POINT.findall(body))
        charts[metric]=points;counts[metric]={'points':len(points),'algorithms':algorithms}
    assert set(charts)==set(CHARTS.values())
    return charts,counts

def extract(source_dir):
    datasets=[]
    for dataset,distance,file in DATASETS:
        path=source_dir/file;charts,counts=parse_page(path); points=charts['qps']; selections=[]
        for floor in ['0.95','0.99','1.0']:
            qualifying=[p for p in points if Decimal(p['recall'])>=Decimal(floor)]
            selections.append({'floor':floor,'qualifying_curve_points':len(qualifying),'winners':[]})
            if not qualifying:continue
            best=max(Decimal(p['value'])for p in qualifying)
            for winner in [p for p in qualifying if Decimal(p['value'])==best]:
                entry=dict(winner)
                entry['twice_archived_qps']=str(2*Decimal(winner['value']))
                entry['qps_points_sharing_label']=sum(p['algorithm']==winner['algorithm']and p['label']==winner['label']for p in points)
                entry['auxiliary_metrics']={m:[p for p in ps if p['algorithm']==winner['algorithm']and p['label']==winner['label']and Decimal(p['recall'])==Decimal(winner['recall'])]for m,ps in charts.items()if m!='qps'}
                selections[-1]['winners'].append(entry)
        datasets.append({'dataset':dataset,'distance':distance,'k':10,'file':file,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_url':f'https://ann-benchmarks.com/{dataset}_10_{distance}.html','curve_counts':counts,'max_published_curve_recall':str(max(Decimal(p['recall'])for p in points))if points else None,'selections':selections})
    return datasets
